notes: 'config'/'appConfig' mirror the source file's makeConfig()/makeAppConfig() test helpers and their defaults (paperJarPath "server.jar", minRamGB 1, maxRamGB 2, serverDir "/srv/mc"; javaPath "java", extraFlags ""), overridden per-fixture exactly as each Swift test overrides them.
